CONTEXT: BeLikeNative Chrome extension. Building backlink pipeline with anchor text rotation.

TASK: Design a deterministic anchor text rotation algorithm.
- Input: slug, platform, article_number
- Output: anchor text, target URL, link type
- Requirements:
  - 60-70% branded anchors ('BeLikeNative', 'belikenative.com', 'the BeLikeNative extension', 'BeLikeNative Chrome extension')
  - 20-25% generic ('read more', 'check this out', 'this tool', 'learn more', 'click here', 'see here')
  - 8-12% partial match ('AI writing assistant', 'grammar tool for Chrome', 'writing extension')
  - 2-5% exact match ('AI writing tool', 'grammar checker', 'Chrome writing extension')
- Must be deterministic (same inputs = same output)
- Must distribute evenly across 2,199 articles
- Provide complete bash function implementation
- Include distribution tracking and weekly balance check script
- Include per-platform variation (same article gets different anchor on different platforms)
